rubricScores.criterion: Recognized that FS0039 errors occur ONLY on net472
Identified undefined symbols as .NET-only hot-reload/loading APIs
Noted small number of net10.0 FS0001 errors as separate real problem

scenarios.scenario: Analysis — Diagnose the root cause of the compiler errors
scenarios.reasoning: The agent ran an efficient, evidence-driven investigation (comparing the two fsc command lines' reference sets) and correctly nailed the dominant root cause: unconditional inclusion of .NET Core-only HotReload sources in the net472 multi-target leg, with FS0072 as cascade. The fix suggestions are practical and correct. However, it overgeneralized — claiming all 170 errors belong to net472 and declaring the net10.0 leg healthy — and confidently fabricated an overload-resolution explanation for FS0001/FS0193 rather than verifying which leg emitted them. That misses one full rubric criterion and undermines confidence in the completeness of the diagnosis.
